name: Commission proposal
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directives 2009/43/EC and 2009/81/EC, as regards the simplification of intra-EU transfers of defence-related products and the simplification of security and defence procurement
part_text:
The report sets out Parliament's position on new EU rules for moving defence equipment between member states and for buying defence and security goods. It wants faster, simpler licensing for cross-border transfers, especially for joint European projects, and easier procurement rules so governments can restock quickly. It also adds conditions: more support for small firms, limits on non-EU parts, and stronger review and reporting duties.

- Member states must exempt more cross-border defence transfers from prior authorisation, including joint European projects and crises.
- Procurement thresholds rise, new buying procedures are added, and non-EU content is capped at 35 percent in common purchases.
- Parliament adopted this position; talks with member states on the final law come next.
